_about: Player-facing patch notes, keyed by release tag, newest first. Add an entry when a build is published; a release with no entry shows a generic line. English only.
build-20261115-0243: Worldforge now runs on Mac, and updates itself the same way the Windows version does.
New portrait art for two Fervent units.
build-20261114-1733: Install once, then the game keeps itself up to date.
Updates ask before downloading, and fetch only the parts that changed.
